g.text: Design pattern 3 — State (GPS signal of an active trip)
overdue when arrival time has passed.
Problem solved: what passengers may be told depends on the
freshness of GPS data. Each state owns its transitions and its
presentation rule, so no status switch statements are spread
through the code. States are stateless singletons (module-private
classes reached through the SignalStates constant); restoring a
trip after a restart sets LIVE directly.
